UnitStatement: Large language models can accelerate engineering work.
Outputs from large language models carry no intrinsic epistemic warrant.
Correct and incorrect LLM-generated claims are produced by the same mechanism and have the same surface properties.
Chirality is presented as a formally specified agent operating system for governing LLM-based agents in regulated professional engineering practice.
Chirality makes the epistemic status of every claim transparent and auditable instead of attempting to improve model reliability.
Chirality uses mandatory provenance, no-invention rules, conflict surfacing, and epistemic labeling to make claim status transparent and auditable.
The thesis contribution is developed as a philosophical framework for professional accountability.
The thesis contribution is developed as an architectural pattern for governed agent execution.
The thesis contribution is developed as a concrete filesystem-native implementation.
The Chirality architecture rests on four philosophical pillars: ontology, epistemology, praxiology, and axiology.
Epistemology is identified as the load-bearing pillar because its removal most directly defeats support for professional reliance.
The epistemology has a formal ontology consisting of six primitives: claim, warrant, status, gap, conflict, and ruling.
Relationships among claim, warrant, status, gap, conflict, and ruling constitute the substrate of the epistemic layer.
The warrant lifecycle states are UNWARRANTED, CITED, REVIEWED, and AUTHENTICATED.
The warrant lifecycle tracks the epistemic state of claims interleaved with the deliverable production lifecycle.
The four pillars are presented as a compact framework for professional accountability, not as the only possible ontology for every domain.
A constitutive gap lies between claim and warrant, meaning and commitment, and content and accountability.
Professional judgment is enacted in the constitutive gap between chiral components of knowledge.
The Chirality architecture holds the constitutive gap open and makes both sides inspectable.
The four-document production kit consists of Datasheet, Specification, Guidance, and Procedure.
The four-document production kit mirrors the philosophical structure at the deliverable level.
Knowledge at every level has a chiral structure of complementary, non-superimposable components.
The pairing of complementary, non-superimposable components is what knowing means in the thesis framing.
The APEGA practice standard Relying on the Work of Others and Outsourcing can be interpreted to govern AI agent use.
AI agent use can be governed through the same professional obligations that govern reliance on human-prepared work.
Professional obligations are defined by what the professional must do, not by what the worker is.
Chirality maps direct supervision and control under APEGA Section 3.1.1 to specific traceable architectural mechanisms.
Chirality maps thorough review under APEGA Section 3.1.2 to specific traceable architectural mechanisms.
The APEGA interpretation offered by the thesis is conservative and professionally grounded rather than a regulatory ruling.
The system has been implemented with governed agent instruction files.
The system has been implemented with deterministic tools.
The system has been implemented with a desktop application.
The system has a three-layer invariant system with 39 formally stated invariants and four-layer enforcement.
Active membership is maintained in source registries rather than mutable count prose.
Classical systems engineering disciplines are treated as primary mechanisms for coordinating agents, containing failures, and preserving human authority.
Classical systems engineering disciplines are not treated as compliance artifacts applied after the fact.
